scope: Local working tree and production build; isolated Chromium sessions on Windows.

economy.assumptions: Stable work and maintained health; excludes stochastic illness, job loss and survival risk.

guarantees: Compound clues required in advanced cases

findings.status: Manual update path implemented and verified in real Chrome
findings.title: A downloaded update remains waiting after a normal reload to the lobby
reproduction: Install and control the built game with a real service worker on localhost.
Open the cached game offline, reconnect and serve a second worker/cache version.
Verify the new worker is installed and waiting while the game stays open.
Reload to the lobby without clearing browser data.
findings.actual: The explicit update button loads the new build while preserving saves; offline reopening and settings-based live saves now pass. Historical automatic-activation root cause was not re-established.
findings.impact: Some update scenarios may leave players on old code. Save data was preserved.
findings.limitation: Reproduced in headless local Chrome both with native networking and request interception, and in a separate online-only probe. No deployed-site or physical-device reproduction.
findings.mitigation: Added five-second deadlines to optional CDN/font requests, extended skip-waiting message lifetime, and prevented update checks during activation. Unit tests pass, but these changes have not resolved the real-browser timeout.

findings.status: Fixed and verified: all 47 original browser suites pass without in-memory isolation
findings.title: Three browser checks have expectations that predate dating costs and marital-affair events
findings.actual: Story fixtures now suppress random affair opportunities explicitly; cash assertions include dating expenses through forecastNextYear. Rescue rewards also account for the debt mood penalty.
findings.verification: All three passed after isolating their fixtures in memory from those unrelated mechanics, including 208 later-life paths.
findings.recommendation: Use forecast-derived expected money; explicitly suppress unrelated random events in story-focused fixtures; add separate tests for their priority interactions.

findings.status: Fixed and verified at five viewport sizes
findings.title: Garden labels are small on phones
findings.actual: Garden plot names and seasonal market badges now use 12px text. No small-text findings in the 240-state audit.
findings.recommendation: Increase plot labels and badges to at least 12px and inspect the garden layout on a real phone.

findings.status: Fixed and verified at five viewport sizes
findings.title: Detective rules summary has a 25px-high tap area
findings.recommendation: Add vertical padding or min-height around 40–44px.
findings.actual: Detective rules summary has a minimum 44px height and vertical padding. No small touch-target findings in the 240-state audit.

balanceObservations: All 96 controlled stable-income profiles eventually reached one billion VND. Median first-billion ages were 32.5 (single), 33 (family), 36 (comfort), and 37 (entry-level).

This measures cash flow under stable conditions, not the difficulty of surviving a full life. The three random UI-fuzz lives ended by age 31, so that sample cannot establish late-life survival balance.
No duplicate reward collection or forecast/collection mismatch was detected by the executed mechanics suites.
limitations: Chromium and simulated viewports; no physical Android/iPhone or Safari run.
No live deployment load test or real-user retention/playtime study.
External CDN availability and final online font rendering were not verified.
The service-worker timeout is retained as an investigation finding, not a claim that all production updates fail.
